paletteOrigin: assets/source/old-site/cover2.png (Season One sleeve, watercolour by Julia Feisleben)

motion.wordmarkSoakIn: opacity 0 to 1, background-size 150% 260% to 100% 100%, saturate 0.3 to 1, 1900ms ease-out-expo, runs once, never loops
motion.hypeSticker: transform 240ms ease-out-expo, rotate -8deg to -4deg on hover
motion.reducedMotion: the wordmark renders finished with no animation; smooth scrolling off
motion.webgl: none; the site ships no canvas and no animation library
motion.backgroundWaves: per mark two animations on periods that never line up: a closed path (15s/20s/17s, linear infinite) with non-uniform scale so the silhouette changes rather than slides, and a density that breathes (11s/13s/16s, ease-in-out alternate); --stain-phase offsets marks sharing a lane; four to five overlapping marks per section. Measured at 38-50px of travel and 66-107px of billow in three seconds. None under reduced motion.
motion.printHover: translateY(-3px) with a deeper sleeve shadow, 320ms ease-out-expo
motion.lyricsPanel: sheet-in 260ms ease-out-expo on open; native dialog handles focus, Escape and return
motion.wolvesGhost: ghost-gather 26s linear infinite, opacity 0 to the mark's resting strength (0.14-0.16) and back while it drifts; three on the site (hero, music, collective), none under reduced motion
motion.reveal: reveal-in on a CSS view timeline, range entry 2% to entry 55%, translateY 14px with scale 0.988, transform only so text never renders at a blended colour; absent without view timelines and under reduced motion
motion.lightbox: sheet-in 240ms ease-out-expo on open; native dialog handles focus, Escape and return
motion.heroPlayer: no motion beyond the card's 2px hover lift; the Bandcamp strip appears on click

wordmark.contrastGuard: the generator fails if any part of the wash drops under 3:1 against #f3f2f0
wordmark.responsive: one line at every width: 7.2cqw above 640px, 13cqw below, against a 13.5cqw break-even

stains.technique: the paint's own density becomes an alpha channel, edges and corners faded so no crop leaves a rectangle; the file carries shape only
stains.usage: mask-image over a token colour, 0.10-0.34 opacity, two or three per section plus at most one wolves ghost, decorative, inside the section, hidden under forced colours and where masks are unsupported; never scale the mask past 100%, which would cut the faded edge into a rectangle

releaseTheming.guard: the generator refuses an accent under 4.5:1 on paper or a wash under 12:1 with ink; tests/unit/release-palette.test.ts asserts it

gallery.layout: CSS column flow: one column, two from 40rem, three from 64rem, break-inside avoid, no cropping
gallery.lightbox: native <dialog>, photograph at max-height 100dvh - 8rem, ink-deep backdrop at 78% with a 4px blur, paper close sticker
gallery.captions: only third-party credits under the thumbnails; the artist's own photographs are credited in the footer

dividers.rule: a 0.5rem band of ink-soft at 0.55, masked by one long stroke stretched to 100% and thinned at both ends
dividers.grounds: tinted sections paint on a ::before so a tiled deckle can tear their top and bottom; mask layers are deckle, plain stencil, mirrored deckle
dividers.fallback: the 1px hairline stays wherever mask-image is unsupported
dividers.exception: tracklist row rules stay hairlines: a printed table wants a clean line

heroPlayer.source: content/site.json heroTrack, checked at build against that release's tracklist
heroPlayer.embed: Bandcamp EmbeddedPlayer track=<id> size=small, bgcol paper, linkcol clay, loaded only on click
heroPlayer.frame: paper card with a hairline and the sticker shadow; a 2.6rem clay disc; the title and frame stay after loading

photographs.treatment: the site's print: 18px radius, sleeve shadow, and grayscale(1) on the hero frame only
photographs.rejected: a warm duotone on a paper mount with a plate line, and a painted dissolve into the page; both read as antique

icon.source: assets/source/logo.png, the artist's own circular emblem
icon.technique: line-art density becomes alpha so the white square drops out; the circular emblem crops itself
icon.colour: ink on transparent for the header, ink on paper for the tab
icon.why paper behind the tab icon: a transparent favicon vanishes on a dark tab strip
